title: AI估值重估：市场关注回报率，谷歌财报能否证明回报？
speaker: Karen Pong

segments.en: Karen, markets are becoming more demanding from you know AI companies. We are seeing some kind of recalibration in your mind. Is that to do with just a simple valuation reset? Is it to do with fundamental questions over AI monetization? What is actually driving that recalibration? And where do you think that takes us going forward?
segments.zh: 市场对AI公司的要求越来越高。我们看到某种重新校准。这仅仅是估值重置，还是对AI变现的根本性质疑？是什么驱动了这种重新校准？未来会走向何方？

segments.en: Okay, if you like we will see we are all the market will like really focus on the market about this Google, their financial season, what is the return on their compacts?
segments.zh: 市场将非常关注谷歌的财报季，看他们的投入回报如何。

segments.en: Of course, if you look at the market, they are not only like care about catacs, they are really care about cash flow and IOI, because like all those CSP and those B companies, they spend a lot from like 2023, but they own less, so the market is not like just care about their catacs, they're looking forward to see the IOI.
segments.zh: 当然，市场不仅关心资本支出，更关心现金流和投资回报率。因为所有云服务商和企业级公司从2023年起投入巨大，但回报较少，所以市场期待看到投资回报率。

segments.en: So if we like call back on the march, the market really excited about that they are acceleration since March, and for now people really are looking forward like like the Google, their like final report, whether the cloud will acceleration from this season, if they can like seeing like a really good acceleration on the Google cloud,
segments.zh: 回顾三月，市场对加速增长很兴奋，现在人们期待谷歌的最终报告，看云业务本季度是否加速，如果能见到谷歌云的良好加速，

segments.en: I think the market, they are like the reset, and also the bond, these two like two weeks, three weeks, the market will find like a good like a better optimism in the future, because they were like seeing the really big company, they can make money,
segments.zh: 我认为市场会重置，未来两三周市场会找到更好的乐观情绪，因为他们看到大公司能赚钱，

segments.en: and they can like have a good return on their like numerous like catacs spend all these years.
segments.zh: 并且能从多年的大量资本支出中获得良好回报。
